engagement_title: Cape Marren Coast Alliance shoulder season campaign: bring six member submitted photographs and a licensed coastal set to one warm October look, rebuild the member trail cards from the file that went to press, and hand the board a launch set it can edit when the dates move
vertical: Regional destination marketing, a coastal visitor alliance of independent member businesses pushing shoulder season visits, plus a printed member trail card run displayed in member windows (Atlantic seaboard, North America)
real_brief_anchor: The reconciled ledger carries NO verbatim posted brief for this row, and this task says so rather than fabricating a quotation. It is anchored instead to the shape that recurs continuously on Upwork and Freelancer.com under regional tourism and destination marketing: a small visitor board or business alliance with a thin photo library, member submitted photographs of wildly mixed quality, a printed piece a previous printer produced whose working file nobody holds, and a request to 'license some shots and make them all look like one campaign'. That request is precisely what the killed original modelled, and it is why the ledger's own triage recorded PHOTO-29 as two surfaces with no decision density: sourcing plus a shared grade is the first day of a destination campaign, not the campaign. The fuller commission a board of this size actually carries is the shoulder season push itself: the member businesses have to be in it or they will not fund it, the trail card has to be reprinted with this year's members and this year's opening months, and the opening months move, which is why the board's own coordinator has to be able to edit the launch set without coming back. Cape Marren, the alliance and every member business are coined for this benchmark; no real place, board, business or trademark is named anywhere.
client_one_liner: We are pushing October to April, our members sent us whatever photographs they had, the trail cards have to be reprinted with this year's members, and our opening months change often enough that we cannot keep coming back to you.
client_brief:
Cape Marren Coast Alliance, shoulder season campaign

I am Nell, the coordinator. We are twenty two independent businesses along the Cape Marren coast and our problem is the calendar. Summer takes care of itself. October to April is when our members either make a living or do not, and the visitor who comes then is a different visitor: a couple or a pair of friends, thirty to sixty, driving up for two or three nights and spending two hundred to six hundred dollars across a weekend on rooms, meals, cider and a walk.

We want the campaign to feel like that season honestly. Warm, low light, weather, wool, quiet. What we do not want is a summer campaign with the saturation turned up, because people arrive in November and find the sea is grey and the cafe shuts at four, and then they write about it. We also do not want it so bleak and literal that nobody books.

Our own library is thin. Six of our members sent us photographs they had. Please use them, because members who cannot see themselves in the campaign do not renew, and fill the gaps with a small number of coastal photographs we can license, chosen the way a designer chooses. Then make the whole thing look like one campaign rather than a pile of pictures from different weekends.

We need a wide picture for the top of the site, and square, tall and vertical versions for the feed and the stories.

Every member displays a trail card in their window. Our old printer ran them and holds only the file that went to press. This year's list is different, the opening months are different, and each card carries something of that member's own. We want the run, a proof of each and a file per member.

The campaign page and the social set have to stay ours to edit, because our members change their opening months more or less monthly.

And a note on what you did and what we should watch.
price_band_and_audience: Discretionary spend of 200 to 600 dollars per visitor party across a two or three night shoulder season weekend, travellers 30 to 60, driving from within four hours, mostly couples and pairs of friends rather than families. The band is load bearing in both directions. At this spend the campaign has to promise a real place in real weather: warm low sun, wool, wet stone, a lit window at four in the afternoon, quiet compositions with one or two people, and type that reads as editorial rather than promotional. Pushed up toward a 1,500 dollar luxury coastal weekend it would go near monochrome and near empty, which strands the cider barn and the bakery that fund the alliance and misrepresents what the coast actually offers. Pushed down into a peak summer treatment, saturated blue water, hard sun, crowded harbour, it sets an expectation November cannot meet, and the coordinator has already named that failure in writing: visitors who arrive to a grey sea and a cafe shut at four write about it. Either extreme costs the board member renewals, which is the money that pays for this. A posted job of this shape runs 1,200 to 3,000 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.sector: Regional destination marketing, an alliance of independent coastal member businesses
brand_identity.founded_place_size: A visitor alliance of twenty two independent member businesses along the Cape Marren coast on the North American Atlantic seaboard. Coordinated by Nell on behalf of the members. Small, member funded, regional in reach.
brand_identity.about: Cape Marren Coast Alliance markets a stretch of independent coast to shoulder season visitors. Summer sells itself; the work is October to April, when a harbour seafood room, a cider barn, a point light, a bookshop, a bakery and an oyster landing either make a living or do not. The campaign has to feel like that season honestly: warm low sun, weather, wool, wet stone, a lit window at four in the afternoon, quiet compositions with one or two people. Members have to see themselves in it, because members who cannot see themselves do not renew.
brand_identity.audience: Travellers aged 30 to 60, driving from within four hours, mostly couples and pairs of friends rather than families. They spend 200 to 600 dollars per party across a two or three night shoulder season weekend on rooms, meals, cider and a walk.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Mid range and real. Positioned above a peak summer holiday treatment (which would oversell blue water and hard sun) and below a 1,500 dollar luxury coastal weekend (which would go near monochrome and strand the bakery and the cider barn). Editorial rather than promotional, and never promising a season the coast cannot deliver in November.
brand_identity.typography: Editorial, not promotional. A quiet serif for headlines with a plain sans for captions, trail numbers and opening months. Restrained weights, comfortable spacing, nothing that reads as a sale.
brand_identity.voice: Grounded and truthful. Warm about the place without overselling it, and specific about what a visitor will actually find when they arrive out of season.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: No written brand guidelines exist. The only brand file on hand is the alliance mark left by the previous agency, supplied as a single vector file with nothing else: no color system, no type list and no usage notes. Members submit their own photographs and object shots, and the campaign look is set by this brief rather than by any existing kit.
brand_identity.values: Honesty about the season, keeping every member visible, and supporting the independent businesses that fund the alliance.

assets_supplied.name: member_photos/ (6 frames, 1400 to 5200 px, mixed provenance)
assets_supplied.kind: One photograph from each of six member businesses: a harbour seafood room, a cider barn, the point light, a bookshop, a bakery counter and an oyster landing. Shot by the members themselves over two seasons on phones and one compact camera.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Six of our members sent us what they had. They are all different and I know it."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Three were taken on the same flat overcast morning where the sea and the sky sit within a hair of each other in value, so a warm move that lifts the whole field carries the water with it and the horizon simply stops existing. One is a phone panorama with a stitch seam running through the harbour wall, and one is 1400 px on the long edge, which no wide placement in the set can carry and nothing can enlarge.

assets_supplied.name: member_objects/ (6 object photographs, approx 3000 px)
assets_supplied.kind: One signature object per member, shot on whatever surface was to hand: a cider press wheel, a lobster creel, the point light's lamp, a stack of secondhand books, a proving basket and an oyster knife.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Each member picked one thing that is theirs. They are meant to go on the cards."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Three of the six have enclosed interiors, the creel's weave, the lamp's railing and the basket's open mouth, and a single knockout returns them as solid blobs with the interior filled by whatever was behind them while reporting success. The oyster knife was shot lying on brushed steel, so its blade and its ground are the same material and the edge is where any cutout will bite.

assets_supplied.name: trailcard_2025_print.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The printer's flat press PDF for last year's member trail card, 105 x 148 mm portrait, fonts embedded, produced from a real page layout so it converts cleanly. Carries the member name, the trail number, a one line description, the opening months, a contact line and a placed object photograph.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "What our old printer sent to press. We do not have anything else."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The readout of the card's copy silently omits the run carrying the opening months line while keeping its line break, so the string still reads as well formed prose and every character offset after it is short by exactly that run's length. The validator returns valid on the resulting arithmetic and the placeholder step reports success, while two of the fields never become placeholders.

assets_supplied.name: members_2027.csv
assets_supplied.kind: Export from the alliance's membership spreadsheet, one row per member, with columns for member, trail number, description, opening months, contact and an object photograph filename.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "This year's members, their numbers and their opening months."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Seven rows for six cards, because a business that closed in February is still on the list. Two members appear under their registered trading names rather than the names the board uses in campaign copy, and the photograph column's filenames carry an extension that does not match the files supplied.

assets_supplied.name: alliance_mark.svg
assets_supplied.kind: The alliance's mark as the previous agency left it, a vector file of the Cape Marren compass and lettering.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Our mark. The agency that made it sent us this file and nothing else."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The file carries the mark inside a full canvas white rectangle at path index zero and declares no viewBox, so it boxes out whatever ground it is placed on and will not scale in an authored page until both are fixed by hand. Its lettering also sits at a weight that begins closing up at the size the trail card actually reproduces it.

assets_supplied.name: board_note.txt
assets_supplied.kind: A page from Nell: the six members and what each is for, how the board talks about the season, what the campaign must not promise, and the two names the board writes differently from the spreadsheet.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The members, the season, and what we must not promise people."

acceptance_bar: Every frame in the campaign reads as one shoulder season rather than as a pile of weekends: one warm target, one black point, one crop logic across member submitted and licensed photography alike.

The member photographs are genuinely in the campaign, not quietly replaced by licensed frames. If a member frame could not carry the placement it was chosen for, the note names the member, the reason and what carries it instead.

Nothing promises a season the coast cannot deliver. No water is a colour that water is not in November, no sky is invented, and any frame taken far enough to read as July fails even if it looks better.
Sea and sky remain readable as two things wherever they meet. A horizon that has stopped existing is a failed frame regardless of how warm it looks.

No delivered file exceeds its source frame's pixel dimensions and no crop's tradeoff record carries an upscale entry. Where a placement could not be reached by cropping, the note says what was done to that frame.
Every licensed frame is genuine photography with generative tech candidates excluded, and every licensed asset id appears in the source manifest.
The six member objects come back on one campaign ground as a set: enclosed interiors actually open rather than filled and plausible, and the edge holding where object and ground share a material.
Exactly one printed card per current member, no extra card and no missing card. If the number shipped is not the number asked for, the note says which row was left out and why.

Every card carries all the lines last year's card carried, including the opening months, and every opening months line and every description is this year's text with members named the way the board names them in copy.
Each per member file contains the card its filename claims, established by opening it rather than by the order the files came back in, and each card carries its own member's object.
The proofs are rendered at true print resolution at card trim rather than at screen scale.

The campaign page and the social canvases come back as one native editable document at their own canvas sizes, with every photograph actually visible, the alliance mark as live vector shapes on a transparent ground rather than a white box, and every text element carrying its licensed face at that family's own numeric weight.

A written note: what was applied to each frame and why the member submitted and licensed photography needed different corrections to arrive at the same place, the type system by role, every membership row questioned and its resolution, every resize any tool reported, and what the board should watch when it edits the launch set itself.

trajectory.action: Confirm the account tier, pull the authoring playbook, and settle the split: trail cards to the merge surface, campaign page and social canvases to authored roots, photography and cutouts to imaging.
trajectory.judgement: The cards are record per page against a layout the old printer already owns; the campaign page must stay editable because opening months change monthly, which the merge surface structurally cannot give.
trajectory.produces: A written plan naming surface per deliverable and the confirmed account tier.

trajectory.action: Upload the six member frames, the six object photographs, the press PDF, the membership export, the alliance mark and the coordinator's note, holding each presigned URL.
trajectory.judgement: A manifest keyed by member, because most of these files will exist in three states before the end and identity per member is what the whole run depends on.
trajectory.produces: A manifest of presigned URLs keyed by member and by role.

trajectory.action: Preview everything and triage per member: what light each frame was shot under, what its native scale and aspect are, whether it carries a stitch or a defect, and which objects have a coherent silhouette and which do not.
trajectory.judgement: Six members sending six pictures is not one problem six times. A frame below camera scale, a panorama seam and an object with an open weave each need a different decision, and one of those decisions is to say no.
trajectory.produces: A per member triage note: illuminant, native scale, defect, aspect reach and silhouette type.

trajectory.action: Straighten what is off level, then fix the warm shoulder season target off the frames that most honestly carry the season and record what that target is in words.
trajectory.judgement: The target is the campaign's whole promise, and it has to be a place the coast can actually be in November rather than the warmest of the six frames.
trajectory.produces: A stated target and levelled masters.

trajectory.action: Search with short generic queries, filter to photography, exclude generative tech candidates, shortlist two moods against the band and defend the pick, then license and download at full resolution.
trajectory.judgement: Long descriptive queries return nothing and the orientation filter always returns zero, so neither is used. The licensed frames must sit beside member photography, not outclass it into irrelevance.
trajectory.produces: Two defended shortlists, licensed camera scale frames and a source manifest.

trajectory.action: Bring the licensed frames to the target, then bring each of the six member frames toward the same target with its own call, recording parameters per member.
trajectory.judgement: Every frame needs a different route to one destination, and the board has ruled out both a summer look and a bleak one, so how far each correction goes is the judgement rather than how good it can be made to look.
trajectory.produces: Graded masters at source scale with a per member parameter log.

trajectory.action: Lay the graded member frames and the licensed frames together as the campaign page will lay them and judge them as one campaign.
trajectory.judgement: Judging the set at the only moment the comparison exists, and deciding what one campaign means if a member frame will not join without becoming dishonest.
trajectory.produces: A campaign contact set judged as a set, with the reasoning recorded.

trajectory.action: Derive the wide banner and the 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 placements at native scale, reading confidence and tradeoffs on every call, and decide what happens to the frame that cannot reach the wide shape.
trajectory.judgement: A frame below the banner's own scale cannot be rescued and a low confidence subject crop that reports success can still be clipping the subject. The tradeoff record is the only honest signal.
trajectory.produces: Placement crops per member and a record of which frames took which route.

trajectory.action: Produce the six member object cutouts on the campaign ground, choosing the instrument per object rather than running one move six times.
trajectory.judgement: An enclosed interior cannot be punched by a background removal at all, and an object lying on its own material is where any edge decision will show. Some objects want a positive selection inverted; some want the one call knockout onto the ground.
trajectory.produces: Six object cutouts on one campaign ground, with the instrument and reasoning recorded per object.

trajectory.surface: Vector hygiene and Creative Cloud storage
trajectory.action: Repair the supplied alliance mark: remove the full canvas white rectangle at path index zero, inject a real viewBox, and produce the variant the trail card's reproduction size actually needs.
trajectory.judgement: A mark that boxes out its ground is unusable on photography, and a weight that closes up small is a reproduction decision rather than a file decision.
trajectory.produces: A transparent, scalable alliance mark plus a small use variant.

trajectory.surface: Data preparation and Creative Cloud storage
trajectory.action: Reconcile the membership export against the coordinator's note, normalise it into a merge shaped data file with an at prefixed image column holding bare filenames matching the cutouts, upload those cutouts and build the image map.
trajectory.judgement: Real reconciliation: a closed business is still listed, two members are written under trading names the board never uses in copy, and the filenames do not match the files. What is the agent's call and what is Nell's has to be said rather than done silently.
trajectory.produces: The merge data file, the uploaded cutouts, the image map and a list of membership questions.

trajectory.action: Convert the press PDF, export the interchange file, unzip it and read the real frame inventory, the integer page item ids and the bounds, then reconstruct each frame's true story text by concatenating its content runs.
trajectory.judgement: The offsets have to be computed from the document itself rather than from any convenience readout, because a readout is a summary and a summary is not evidence.
trajectory.produces: The converted document, its interchange export, a frame inventory with real bounds, and a reconstructed story string.

trajectory.action: Author the mapping covering every copy field and the object frame, validate it, prepare the template, then export the interchange file from the RESULT and search for every placeholder the mapping claimed to create.
trajectory.judgement: Not accepting a success message or a valid verdict as evidence, and ordering any rows sharing a uid so their positions hold against the original text.
trajectory.produces: A prepared template whose placeholder inventory has been independently confirmed.

trajectory.action: Merge to a native document with the per row objects bound, then render the card run and the board's proofs at true print resolution from that document, and produce the per member files, naming each by opening it.
trajectory.judgement: Merging to the native document first keeps both branches open, and identity by position in a returned list is the fast wrong answer that puts the bakery's basket on the oyster landing's card.
trajectory.produces: The card run, print resolution proofs, and per member files verified by inspection.

trajectory.action: Read every rendered card at trim rather than at proof scale, line by line, and look at the alliance mark where it actually sits on the card.
trajectory.judgement: Reading the output rather than the log. A missing opening months line, a trading name where a campaign name belongs and a mark that has closed up all look like success at the API boundary.
trajectory.produces: A card by card reconciliation and an honest look at the mark at its real reproduction size.

trajectory.action: Ask for recommendations once per role, pull the style inventories for the real numeric weights, launder every name into canonical form, and build one kit.
trajectory.judgement: The pairing is the agent's own and has to land editorial rather than promotional at a 200 to 600 dollar weekend. The weight cannot be inferred from a style name and a display cut is reached by its own slug.
trajectory.produces: A one kit type system with family, foundry and actual numeric weight per role.

trajectory.action: Author one self contained HTML with the campaign page, the wide web banner and the 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 social canvases, inline every photograph as image data, place the repaired mark as inline SVG inside an explicitly sized top left anchored wrapper, declare family and weight per text element, then upload and hold the URL.
trajectory.judgement: A photograph left as a URL is not a photograph, an auto sized right anchored wrapper throws its contents off the canvas, and a global canvas override collapses a mixed size set. The design work is holding white type over November light without lying about the weather.
trajectory.produces: One export ready HTML carrying the whole campaign set, retained as the durable source.

trajectory.action: Run the readiness check, export by URL, then verify canvas one from the document's rendition and every other canvas from the returned per canvas markup, element by element.
trajectory.judgement: The rendition shows the first artboard only, so every canvas after the first exists for verification purposes solely as returned markup, and success is not fidelity.
trajectory.produces: A native editable document, an inspected first canvas and a per canvas markup audit.

trajectory.action: Persist the shortlist board the marketing committee signs off from within the placement cap, re sending only entries named as failed, then write the note.
trajectory.judgement: A 201 is partial success and the vector mark is not boardable, so it belongs in the note. The note has to name every membership row questioned and what the board should watch when it edits the launch set itself.
trajectory.produces: A persistent shareable board with nothing silently dropped, and the written handover.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the shared warm target does to the members who were shot on a flat overcast morning. On those frames the sea and the sky sit within a hair of each other in value, so the warm move that gives the licensed frames their late October light lifts the whole flat field at once: the water takes the warmth with the sky, the two surfaces converge rather than separate, and the horizon stops existing. The frame does not look broken at contact scale, it looks soft and slightly hazy, and it is only at placement scale beside the licensed frames that the coast turns out to have no edge. Where that convergence happens is a property of that particular morning's light on that particular water, there is no measurement anywhere in the connector to establish how close the two values started, and the intermediate results are all plausible.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it: the target has to be fixed before any member frame can be corrected toward it, and the convergence only exists once the move has been made and the result is looked at beside the rest of the set. (b) Nothing states it: the brief says the members sent whatever they had and asks for one campaign, which is the client's account and the client's requirement. The acceptance line about a readable horizon is the board's standing quality bar, not a disclosure of cause. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the response re decides what one campaign means, which changes the target itself and therefore every frame already corrected toward it, and it changes which members can carry which placements.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Either re set the target to a warmth all six member mornings can honestly take, and re correct the frames already brought to the old target, or hold the target and give the overcast members a confined treatment that warms the sky and the land while leaving the water where it is, then re judge the whole set adjacent to confirm they still read as one campaign. If neither holds, the campaign's consistency has to be carried by crop logic, type and the object cutouts instead, which changes what leads the page and what each member's placement is.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Three member businesses appear in a paid shoulder season campaign in frames where the sea and the sky have merged into one warm grey field with no horizon, on a campaign whose entire promise is that the coast in November is worth the drive, and those three members are among the ones whose renewals pay for the work.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the mapping built against the old printer's card actually landed. The readout of the card's copy silently omits the run carrying the opening months while keeping its line break, so the string still reads as well formed prose and every character offset after it is short by exactly that run's length. The validator returns valid on internally consistent wrong arithmetic with no warnings at all, the preparation step reports that placeholder creation completed successfully, and two of the fields never become placeholders. Nothing anywhere in the chain disagrees with the wrong number.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it and diligence alone cannot either, because the failure is produced by a lossy readout that presents as complete: an agent that reads carefully and computes offsets faithfully from what it was handed produces arithmetic that is internally consistent and wrong, and every downstream tool agrees. The only defence is a second independent reconstruction of the same text from a different channel, which nothing in any tool description prompts and whose necessity is invisible until the two disagree. (b) Nothing states it: the brief mentions no frames, fields or mappings, only that the opening months are different this year. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the source of truth changes, from a tool readout to offset arithmetic computed against a reconstructed story with same uid rows re ordered, and the mapping is re authored from a different text rather than re fed.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Reconstruct the true story text by concatenating the exported document's content runs, recompute every offset against that string, re order any rows sharing a uid into descending position order, rebuild and re validate the mapping, re run the template preparation and verify by exporting the interchange file from the prepared template and searching for every placeholder before any card is merged.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Every member's trail card goes into every member's window carrying last year's opening months as static printed text, in a campaign whose entire subject is when the coast is open, and the board finds out from visitors who drove up and found the door locked.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: How the importer normalises the campaign page's treatment of type over photography. The warm wash that lets white type hold over a November harbour frame, and the soft stacked shadow under the opening months band, are both authored constructs whose fate is decided entirely inside the importer: the blend collapses to a plain opaque shape that covers the photograph beneath it, and only the first shadow layer survives, so the band loses the separation it was designed around. Every one of these drops returns success with no warning of any kind. The document's rendition shows the first artboard only, so on canvases two through five the returned per canvas markup is the only channel through which any of it is observable, and the page looks entirely correct in the source that was authored.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it, because the normalisation is a property of the importer applied to this particular construct, and there is no dry run: the export is the only readout. (b) Nothing states it: the brief asks for a campaign page and social set the board can edit and says nothing about how anything is built. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the technique that carries white type over photography changes, which changes which crop of which frame can hold the type, which sends the agent back to the imaging surface for a differently framed or differently graded master before the page can be re authored at all.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re author the treatment with constructs the importer keeps rather than the ones it drops, resolve the type over photography problem in the photograph instead of in the overlay by choosing or re deriving a frame with a quiet corner at the size the type needs, re inline the new master, re run the readiness check and re export, then audit every canvas from the returned markup rather than from the rendition.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The board is handed an editable document in which the campaign page and three of the four social canvases show an opaque warm panel sitting over the photograph it was meant to sit within, with the headline type and the opening months band floating on a flat rectangle, and nobody sees it because the only view anyone checked was the first artboard.

deliverables.name: Cape Marren shoulder season photography, six member frames plus the licensed coastal set
deliverables.spec: Six member submitted frames and the licensed coastal frames brought to one warm shoulder season target (one warmth, one black point, one crop logic) without promising a season the coast cannot deliver and without collapsing the horizon on the overcast mornings, delivered as one wide web banner and 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 placements. decision_gates: Which deliverables go to the merge surface and which to authored canvases, given cards the old printer already owns and opening months that change monthly.
What the warm shoulder season target actually is, given it has to be a place the coast can be in November rather than the warmest of six member frames.
What one campaign means when three member mornings cannot take the shared warmth without losing their horizon, and therefore whether the target moves or the treatment splits.
Which two moods to shortlist from Stock and which to defend, at a band where the licensed frames must sit beside member photography rather than outclass it.
What to do with the member frame that is below the wide banner's own scale, given that nothing can enlarge it and the member expects to be in the campaign.
Which instrument each object cutout needs, since an enclosed interior cannot be punched by a background removal at all and an object on its own material is where the edge shows.
Whether to trust the mapping tool's readout of the printer's text or to reconstruct the story independently from the document, and whether a valid verdict and a success message count as verification.
Whether per member identity is established by position in a returned list or by opening the file.
How white headline type is going to hold over November photography, given that the technique is decided by the importer rather than by the authored source.
The membership list: a closed business still listed, two trading names the board never uses in copy, and filenames that do not match the files. What is the agent's call and what is Nell's.
The type pairing, which the recommender refuses to make, judged editorial rather than promotional.
How much of the campaign is member photography and how much is licensed, which is a political question about renewals as much as a visual one.
why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns a beautiful autumn coast that does not exist. IDENTITY: the campaign's entire commercial function is that six specific member businesses see themselves in it and renew, and the visitor drives to a real cape expecting the sea, the light and the hours the campaign showed. A generated coastline is a place nobody can visit and a member business that is not in the campaign is a member that does not fund the next one. LICENSING: the gap filling photography runs in paid placement and has to be genuinely licensed, provenance clear and free of generative tech candidates. SPEC: the print run needs one 105 x 148 mm card per current member binding opening months verbatim, per member files each containing the card they claim, each carrying that member's own object, and proofs at true print resolution. EDITABILITY: the launch set is defined by being editable, because the members change their opening months monthly and the board cannot come back each time. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: whether this water and this sky can take the campaign's warmth and stay two things, whether a placeholder was ever created, whether the page the board was handed is the page that was designed.
doability_proof: Every link is verified live in CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10, auth account), five surfaces honestly counted, no banned capability and no dead surface. STOCK and BOARDS: asset_search(StockAsset) plus asset_license_and_download_stock is verified fully headless and returned genuine camera scale photography (7360x4912, 6.9 MB), with isGenTech exposed per asset for exclusion, orientation verified BROKEN (always zero hits, never passed) and short queries mandatory (a four word query returned zero where the one word query returned 834). boards_create_new_board and boards_add_items_to_board are verified to persist server side, with the twelve per call cap, 201 meaning partial success and vector unsupported. IMAGING: straighten, apply_adjustments global and masked, select_by_prompt with returnBbox, select_subject, invert_selection, crop_to_bounds, crop_and_resize with its tradeoffs and 2x upscale cap, remove_background in both forms and fill_area are verified headless across 27 live calls. The horizon checkpoint rests on there being NO measurement anywhere in the family (no eyedropper, no histogram, no ruler) and on HSL RANGE HOLDING ONLY AT MODERATE, so both the target and the distance are eye judgements made after the fact. The cutout deliverable rests on two verified findings that force per object instrument choice: remove_background CANNOT PUNCH AN ENCLOSED INTERIOR (it returned a SOLID OPAQUE DISC on a ring badge, 118,823 opaque px where a true knockout would be about 18,000) and the one call backgroundColor form composites a subject onto a solid hex, while select positive then invert is the only route to an open interior. Alpha is verified to survive both crop tools at outputFileType png. MERGE SPINE: building a merge template from a bare press PDF end to end headlessly is verified; one record per page is confirmed for the PDF branch; per record files are confirmed in correct order by two routes while multi record PNG or JPEG URLs came back REVERSED, which is why identity is established by opening the file; true 300 DPI at trim is confirmed through document_render_layout while the merge's own resolution parameter is documented as silently ignored; per row image binding through an at prefixed CSV column plus additionalImageFiles is verified visually. The offset checkpoint is the verified headline trap: generate_indd_mapping_prompt's textContent DROPPED a 17 character run while KEEPING its line break, the validator returned VALID with zero warnings on the resulting offsets, prepare_indd_merge_template reported completed successfully, and only 3 of 5 mappings actually landed; recomputing from the true IDML story landed 6 of 6. EXPRESS: mixed canvas sizes in one export and a genuinely editable native document are verified. The importer checkpoint rests on verified silent drops: mix-blend-mode is DROPPED and the element renders as a plain opaque shape, MULTI LAYER box-shadow is HARD TRUNCATED TO LAYER 1, filter and backdrop-filter and text-shadow are dropped, every drop returns success with no warning, and THE RENDITION PREVIEW SHOWS PAGE 1 ONLY so pages two onward are observable only through slides[].html. Photographs must be base64 inlined because every external image URL resolved to a placeholder grey box, and the payload is routed by uploaded URL because inlined photography passes the 70 KB threshold. FONTS follow the verified chain with find_fonts laundering names, font_styles supplying non standard numeric weights and css_stack slugs in the CSS. AVOIDED: no video or audio, no vector render or vector merge, no upscaling, no object removal, no compositing, no OCR, no bleed or press preset gate, no variable QR, no fill_text, no animate_design, no replace_image, no photo reaching Express as a URL, no batch above 20.
